title: HDF oscal-props carriage tag
description: Shape of the reserved HDF requirement tag `oscal-props` (ADR-0014 §3.3): the OSCAL SAR props the importer carries losslessly through HDF, one entry per source prop in source order. It is a converter convention inside HDF tags, not an HDF schema field. Both the Go and TypeScript carriage tests validate every emitted tag against this file.

on.description: The OSCAL object the prop was attached to.

ns.description: The prop namespace, present exactly when the source prop has one.

class.description: The prop class, present exactly when the source prop has one.

group.description: The prop group, present exactly when the source prop has one.

uuid.description: The prop uuid, present exactly when the source prop has one.

remarks.description: The prop remarks, present exactly when the source prop has them.
